defects_fixed: torchrl Binary defaults to int8 while the env emits bool; boolean leaves use Unbounded(dtype=torch.bool) so the spec matches truthful data (check_env_specs had failed on dtype mismatch)
nested players Composite required the full [N,2] shape, not [2]
independent oracle re-derived its seed after episode_id incremented, replaying the wrong episode; now records used_seed/used_teams
partial reset used reset_batch, invalidating untouched handles; now uses reset_slots_batch on masked slots only
truncation was counted as a completed match (guard was 'term or trunc'); completion now requires term, truncation tracked separately with no payout

F1 (review-found): the 'P1 staged policy packet' test used torch.randint, so no ConditionalPolicy ever reached EnvBase.step() while the receipt claimed it did; now the policy produces the prefix, proven by replay
measurement harness seeded actions from step index only, so the four 'distinct seeds' played an identical sequence; seeding now includes env._seed
N1 (review-found): a step after a truncated episode re-reported terminated=True and lost the winner; concluded rows now re-report the raw flags recorded at commit

identity/branch-count validation gaps (review-found F2-F6): mandatory slot/generation/episode identity, native branch-count equality, candidate membership, fail-closed rejection before step_batch, revision accounting separated from invalidity
p1_code_change: PA3 refuses to resolve token refs for non-PICK actions without the player-known active->roster map, so build_branch_table and ConditionalPolicy now accept and thread observation.active_to_roster(). The parameter is additive and defaults to None; P1 regression remains 39/39 green.
harness_bug_found_and_fixed: The Lead's own measurement harness seeded the action RNG from the step index only, so all four 'distinct seeds' played an identical action sequence. Seeding now includes env._seed; the four games are genuinely distinct (20/11/19/14 steps, winners 0/1/0/1).
limitations: Only 4 seeded games; exactly the G2-B minimum with no margin
The oracle is a second native engine but shares the PA4 decoder path, so decoder bugs would be invisible to it
CPU native stepping only; no GPU simulation or throughput claim
Truncation accounting is proven with a synthetic native result via a transparent proxy; natural play never produced a truncating episode
Max observed legal candidates 18 is an inherited fixture bound, not a global maximum
P1 policy is randomly initialised (seed 20261006); no strength claim
No benchmark or performance optimisation performed
P1 replay still requires the original observation payload
PA3 pin is the public main tip, not verified live production state

notes: One step per native advance attempt; never one step per branch choice and never one step per match.
match_completed is emitted at most once per naturally terminated episode; truncated episodes are not counted as matches.
player_view(seat) is the only policy-facing extraction and returns that seat's own observation only.
All six action-packet keys are required; stale request_id/generation/episode_id, present mismatch, wrong branch count and extra Wait/Finished actions raise before step_batch.
No P3 collector, PPO, profiling or cloud work was performed.
The P2 execution prompt file named in the task does not exist on this machine; work followed PA4-P2-DESIGN-v1.0, which is the authoritative design.
